author: Thomas Watson Steen
html:
I just tried to sign up for Google Analytics to try it out on my [girlfriend’s website](http://www.skolehjemsamtaler.dk/). For a short second I saw a license agreement. But shortly after the license agreement also reloaded and showed me the "Not Found" edition.

As far as I can see it's trying to display me a Danish version - I did not see the other one long enough to read any of it, but I would then believe it was the original English version.
